questions.title: Revenue without losing customers
questions.summary: Return customer_id, name and revenue for every customer.
questions.task: Return customer_id, name and revenue for every customer. Sum only paid orders; customers with no paid orders must have revenue 0. Sort by customer_id.
requirements: Use exact output column names and customer_id ordering.
questions.starter:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name,
       0 AS revenue
FROM customers AS c
ORDER BY c.customer_id;
questions.solution:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS revenue
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND o.status='paid'
GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.name
ORDER BY c.customer_id;
questions.explanation: Putting paid status inside ON preserves the null-extended customer row. COALESCE turns a missing sum into zero. The output grain is one customer, not one order.
